title: Prawn and Melon Salad with Mint and Peanuts
blurb: A light salad combining sweet melon with garlic prawns, fresh mint and roasted peanuts, dressed with lime and fish sauce.
steps: Peel and devein the prawns if needed, then pat them dry.
Peel and finely chop the garlic, and thinly slice the chilli.
Cut the melon into bite-sized cubes and place in a serving bowl.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over high heat, add the garlic and prawns, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the prawns turn pink and are cooked through.
Squeeze the lime juice into a small bowl, add the fish sauce and mix together.
Add the cooked prawns to the melon, tear in the mint leaves, and scatter over the peanuts and chilli.
Pour the dressing over the salad, toss gently, and serve immediately.
